terra.problem: The notes differ about the basis of the right to the tree of life: Jamieson-Fausset-Brown says it is not based on our deeds, while Clarke says it is founded on obedience produced by God’s grace. The meaning does not mention this difference.
A 10-year-old may not understand “grace” or how being made clean “in the blood of the Lamb” is a picture of forgiveness. These need simpler explanation.
